caption:
A bathroom scale doesn't need an app to tell you the truth.

Most scales on shelves now want to sync to your phone, track trends over time, and get you logged into an account before they'll show a single number. That's a lot of setup for something that just needs to measure weight.

This is a digital body weight bathroom scale — you step on, it reads out your weight. No pairing, no login screen, nothing standing between your feet and the number.

You get a basic daily-use scale that does the one job it's for, without extra steps in the way.
